builds.title: Triton harbor guide, monster class 1
builds.difficulty: CR 1 from Table A–48. ECL 1 with 1 class Hit Die.
traits: Neutral good. Natural armor +2. Touch 11, flat-footed 12. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +5, Reflex +3, Will +3.
Weapon Focus (trident). Breathes air and water. May take 10 on Swim even when threatened. Can only run in a straight line in water, and cannot run or charge on land.
actions: Trident +5 melee, 1d8+3 piercing, ×2 critical. Hold it in both hands for 1d8+4.
builds.tactics: Iril uses the deeper channel to get around a threat and leads boats away from submerged rubble. The shell-tipped guide rod shown in the portrait marks shoals. Iril carries a trident for defense.

builds.title: Troll bridge porter, monster class 4
builds.difficulty: CR 2 from Table A–49. ECL 4 with 3 class Hit Dice.
traits: Neutral. Natural armor +3. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +2, grapple +7. Fortitude +7, Reflex +3, Will +1.

Alertness and Multiattack. Regeneration converts damage other than fire or acid to subdual damage and heals 1 point of it per round. Regrows lost parts in 3d6 minutes or reattaches a part by holding it to the injury.
actions: Claw +7 melee, 1d4+5. On a full attack, use two claws at +7 and a secondary bite at +5 for 1d4+2.
builds.tactics: Bral keeps threats off the bridge until the wagons are across. He yields ground to open flames and keeps enough room to back away from them.

builds.title: Trumpet Archon herald, monster class 4
builds.difficulty: CR 3 from Table A–50. ECL 4 with 3 class Hit Dice.
traits: Lawful good. Natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +6. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +6. Add +4 to saves against poison.

Electricity resistance 10. Weapon Focus (greatsword), Improved Initiative. Tongues is continuous at caster level 5. It can be switched off, dispelled, or restored on Orren’s next turn as a free action.
Cleric caster level 5, spell save DC 13 + spell level. Prepared slots from 0th through 3rd are 5/4/3/2, including one bonus slot apiece at levels 1–3 from Wisdom 16.
actions: Trumpet (Su), standard action. Each non-archon within 5 ft. rolls Fortitude DC 13 or is paralyzed for 1d4 rounds. The trumpet changes between instrument and +1 greatsword as a free action.
0th-level prepared spells. Create water twice (10 gallons per casting within 35 ft.), detect magic once (60-ft. cone, concentration up to 5 minutes), light twice (touch, 20-ft. light for 50 minutes).
1st-level prepared spells. Bless twice (+1 morale to allies’ attacks and saves against fear within 50 ft. for 5 minutes), cure light wounds twice (touch, 1d8+5 healing).
2nd-level prepared spells. Cure moderate wounds three times (touch, 2d8+5 healing).
3rd-level prepared spells. Cure serious wounds twice (touch, 3d8+5 healing).

Spell-like abilities, once per day each at caster level 3. Detect evil (60-ft. cone, concentration up to 30 minutes), continual flame (touch one object for lasting heatless light as a torch), and message (130-ft. range, up to 3 recipients, 30 minutes of whispered speech and replies).
builds.tactics: Orren blesses the escort, takes the rear, and saves the trumpet blast for when the witnesses have cleared its range. He uses his flight to check the next landing.

builds.title: Vrock ridge watcher, monster class 7
builds.difficulty: CR 5 from Table A–52. ECL 7 with 4 class Hit Dice.
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., telepathy 100 ft. with creatures that know a language
traits: Chaotic evil. Natural armor +8. Touch 13, flat-footed 18. BAB +4, grapple +9. Fortitude +8, Reflex +7, Will +6.
Weapon Focus (claws) and Multiattack. Poison immunity. Resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, and fire.
actions: Claw +10 melee, 1d8+5. Full attack adds the second claw at +10 and a secondary bite at +7 for 1d6+2. Include two lower-claw rakes at +7 for 1d4+2 each when airborne and adjacent.

Spores (Ex), once per day. Creatures within 5 ft. take 1d8 damage immediately, then 1d2 in each of the next 10 rounds. Delay poison suspends growth during its duration. Bless, neutralize poison, remove disease, or a vial of holy water applied to a victim ends the effect.

Lesser vrock powers, caster level 8. Each usable three times per day. Darkness makes a touched object shed magical darkness in a 20-ft. radius for 80 minutes. Darkvision and mundane light do not pierce it.

Desecrate (lesser power), 45-ft. range and 20-ft. radius for 16 hours. Turning checks take a −3 profane penalty and undead gain +1 profane on attacks, damage, and saves. Undead created or summoned there gain +1 HP per HD. Double these modifiers near a permanent fixture to Krev’s patron. Consecrate cancels it.

Detect good and detect magic (lesser powers) use 60-ft. cones. Minor image (lesser power) creates a figment with limited sound within 720 ft. for concentration plus 2 rounds. Will DC 13 to disbelieve on interaction.
builds.tactics: Krev uses minor image to redirect trespassers, descends when they come close to the slate marker, and uses his spores if surrounded.

builds.title: Water Elemental sluice keeper, monster class 4
builds.difficulty: CR 2 from Table A–53. ECL 4 with 4 class Hit Dice.
traits: Neutral. Natural armor +5. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. BAB +3, grapple +7. Fortitude +8, Reflex +2, Will +2.
Alertness and Weapon Focus (slam), plus bonus Power Attack. Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, and critical hits. Breathes air and water. Can take 10 on Swim even when threatened.
actions: Slam +8 melee, 1d6+6. With Water Mastery, use +9 and 1d6+7 if both touch water, or +4 and 1d6+2 if either is landbound.
Drench (Ex). Any nonmagical fire of Large size or smaller goes out when Sillrun touches it. No attack roll.

Vortex (Su), once every 10 minutes and only underwater. Lasts up to 2 rounds and moves at swim speed. Choose a height of 10–30 ft., with a 5-ft.-wide base and top up to 30 ft. wide. Small or smaller creatures that touch it roll Reflex DC 16 for initial 1d6 damage, then a separate Reflex DC 16 to avoid being caught. Captives take 1d6 each round. Swimmers can save each round to escape, after the damage. Sillrun can release captives at will.

When the vortex touches bottom, a cloud half its height in diameter starts at its center. Treat vision at 5 ft. through the debris as half concealment and farther vision as total concealment. Concentration DC 16 to cast inside.
Water Mastery can overturn craft up to 20 ft. long, stop craft up to 40 ft., or halve a ship’s speed up to 80 ft. of length.
builds.tactics: Sillrun stays in the channel, knocks open flames into the water, and uses the vortex only once swimmers are clear of the gate.

concepts.name: Iril Tidepost
concepts.motive: Find out who cut the lines holding the channel markers.
concepts.hook: Iril surfaces beside the hull with a cut marker line and motions the crew toward the deeper channel.

concepts.name: Bral Toothpeg
concepts.motive: Get the stranded grain wagons over the river before the road washes out.
concepts.hook: Bral props up a sagging bridge plank and asks for help before the next wagon rolls through.

concepts.name: Orren Clearbell
concepts.motive: Escort the witnesses out of the tower so they can deliver a sworn account.
concepts.hook: Orren carries the tower’s broken signal lantern and offers to guide the witnesses down a second stair.

concepts.name: Krev Basaltwill
concepts.motive: Keep travelers away from a slate marker until the toll collector arrives.
concepts.hook: Krev calls into the lead climber’s mind and offers to show a shorter trail in return for a toll.

concepts.name: Sillrun
concepts.motive: Get the miller to clear an old snarl of branches from the lower gate.
concepts.hook: Sillrun rises from the water to hold the gate open, then points downstream to a branch jam.
